focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 静态多组数据横向对比与倍差/占比凸显段（Cross-Group Proportions）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写静态柱状图或饼图的主体段：横向对比不同国家/不同模型在不同开销维度上的占比差异，灵活运用倍数（double/triple）、分数（nearly a third）与排序结构。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 静态图表段 / 论文开销拆解（Breakdown）段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [主导项锁定 Dominant Category]：Regarding [Group 1], [Category A] claims the largest share at [46%], nearly double the proportion allocated to [Category B] ([24%]).
S2 [组间横向反差 Cross-Group Contrast]：A markedly different allocation pattern emerges in [Group 2], where [Category C] dominates at [52%], while [Category A] shrinks to just [15%].
S3 [次要项合并归纳 Minor Categories Grouping]：Meanwhile, the remaining categories—[Category D and E]—collectively account for less than [12%] across both groups.
S4 [结构性差异提炼 Structural Takeaway]：These figures indicate that whereas [Group 1] prioritizes [Function A], [Group 2] concentrates resources heavily on [Function C].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Dominant Item with Multiplier -> Sharp Cross-Group Contrast -> Pooled Minor Items -> Structural Synthesis. 绑定逻辑规则：L009, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In Group 1, A is 46%, B is 24%, C is 18%, D is 7%, and E is 5%. In Group 2, C is 52%, B is 22%, A is 15%, D is 6%, and E is 5%.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 把文字写成了 CSV 表格转储，完全没有归并次要项，也没有提炼倍差与结构反差。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Within edge-device inference workloads, attention matrix computation consumes the largest fraction of total energy at 48%, exactly double the power drawn by feed-forward layers (24%). A strikingly different profile emerges in onboard robotic control loops, where high-frequency sensor preprocessing dominates energy usage at 51%, while attention overhead contracts to just 16%. Across both deployment settings, memory offloading and actuation decoding collectively account for under 11% of total consumption. This contrast highlights that optimization bottlenecks shift from quadratic token mixing on cloud servers to raw sensory I/O on physical robots.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 反事实推理段：如果不采取某项原则，系统将如何一步步滑向失控（Counterfactual Escalation）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文或科研立项书中，通过严密的“反事实推演（If we fail to... / Absent X...）”强化紧迫感与说服力。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 深化论证段，或论文 Motivation 强化段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [正面基准命题 Positive Baseline]：Maintaining rigorous [Principle/Standard X] serves as the primary safeguard against [Systemic Risk Y].
S2 [反事实假设切入 Counterfactual Premise]：Absent this safeguard—if [Actors] were to rely exclusively on [Unchecked Alternative]—[Immediate Vulnerability] would quickly emerge.
S3 [连锁恶化传导 Cascading Deterioration]：Once [Immediate Vulnerability] takes hold, [Secondary Consequence] compounds across cycles, eventually eroding [Core Foundation].
S4 [实证印证或结论锁定 Empirical Echo]：This degradation dynamic mirrors [Real-world/Technical Precedent], underscoring why [Principle X] cannot be compromised for short-term convenience.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Positive Safeguard -> Counterfactual Premise (Absent X...) -> Cascading Breakdown -> Precedent Confirmation. 绑定逻辑规则：L020, L003.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Curating clean human data is very important. If we do not use clean human data and only use AI-generated data to train new AI models, the models will become worse and worse and finally collapse.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 虽然有如果……就会……的意思，但表达过于口语化（worse and worse），缺少“尾部稀缺分布丢失 -> 方差坍缩”的机制链条。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Preserving verified human-authored corpora serves as an indispensable anchor for training successive generations of generative models. Absent this human data anchor—if future models were trained recursively on synthetic outputs generated by their predecessors—subtle approximation errors would compound across iterations. In each recursive cycle, low-probability tail events and nuanced stylistic variations are progressively truncated, driving the learned distribution toward high-density mode collapse. This degenerative feedback loop—known empirically as model autophagy—underscores why synthetic data augmentation can complement, but never wholly replace, curated real-world observations.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 双图关联与互补/因果印证段（Synthesizing Dual Charts）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写双图题（如一张图是算力投入/研发经费变化，另一张图是模型误差/碳排放强度变化）的综合关联段，阐明两张图之间的内在协同或背离关系。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 双图组合题 / 论文多指标联合分析段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [双图联动锚定 Cross-Chart Link]：Synthesizing both charts reveals a clear inverse / positive relationship between [Chart 1 Variable] and [Chart 2 Variable] up to [Threshold Point].
S2 [区间 1 协同变化 Phase 1 Co-movement]：Specifically, as [Variable X in Chart 1] expanded from [A] to [B] during [Period 1], [Variable Y in Chart 2] dropped correspondingly by [C%].

S3 [区间 2 边际递减/背离 Diminishing Returns / Divergence]：However, beyond [Threshold Point], although [Variable X] continued to double, [Variable Y] plateaued around [Value], indicating diminishing marginal returns.
S4 [例外个体点拨 Exception Highlight]：An exception to this pattern is [Entity Z], which achieved the lowest [Variable Y] despite maintaining moderate [Variable X].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Global Correlation -> Co-movement Phase -> Diminishing Returns / Divergence -> Notable Outlier. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L013.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Chart 1 shows R&D spending and Chart 2 shows defect rates. When R&D spending goes up, defect rates go down. Country Z spends little money but has low defect rates.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 极其简陋，未能刻画“初期强相关 -> 超过阈值后边际收益递减 -> 特例分析”的层次感。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Cross-referencing both figures reveals a strong inverse relationship between automated inspection investment and manufacturing defect rates up to a $40 million threshold. Specifically, across plants investing between $10 million and $40 million (Figure 1), surface defect incidence dropped steeply from 4.8% to 0.9% (Figure 2). Beyond $40 million, however, further capital expenditure yielded diminishing returns: doubling investment to $80 million reduced defects by only an additional 0.1 percentage points. Notably, Plant D defied this expenditure curve, achieving a 0.7% defect rate with just $22 million through closed-loop sensor calibration.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 段尾留钩与段首咬合：跨段落无缝过渡法则（Paragraph-to-Paragraph Handshake）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 整篇小论文或大作文不是几个孤立段落的拼盘。上一段的末句应为下一段埋下伏笔，或者下一段的首句用前置状语短语（Having established [Paragraph N's core], we now turn to [Paragraph N+1's core] / While [Paragraph N's factor] accounts for X, [Paragraph N+1's factor] governs Y）完成段间握手。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: End of Para A: ...resolving [Issue X] in isolation is insufficient without addressing [Issue Y]. -> Start of Para B: To address this [Issue Y], we introduce [Module B]...
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 段落之间毫无过渡，上一段讲完频域特征，下一段突然毫无征兆地讲损失函数，像看幻灯片跳页。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: [End of Para 1] ...thus extracting periodic features. [Start of Para 2] Next, we use a contrastive loss function to train the network.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: [End of Para 1] ...thus extracting multi-period representations from raw sensor streams. [Start of Para 2] Having isolated these periodic representations, we next align them across heterogeneous operating regimes via a regime-aware contrastive objective.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Having isolated these periodic representations, we next... 将上一段的输出直接作为下一段损失函数设计的输入，全篇浑然一体。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 去机械连接词化：用语义钩子替代 First/Second/Moreover
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 母语学者与高分作文极少每句句首都贴 Firstly, Secondly, Moreover, What is more, In addition 等膏药。应使用语义承接状语（Beyond accuracy gains, / Alongside temporal drift, / At the hardware level,）实现自然递进。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Instead of 'Moreover, X does Y', use: 'Beyond [Summary of Prior Point], [Subject X] also [Verb Y].'
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 一段 5 句话连续用 First, Second, Besides, Moreover，而句子内部毫无词汇呼应，形成典型的中式“八股排比腔”或 AI 列表腔。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: First, our model reduces MSE by 15%. Second, our model uses 40% less memory. Moreover, our model generalizes to unseen sensors.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Our model reduces forecasting MSE by 15.4% across six benchmarks. Beyond accuracy gains, its sparse attention mechanism cuts peak GPU memory by 40%, enabling zero-shot deployment on unseen sensor arrays.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Beyond accuracy gains 承上启下，用 enabling... 自然引出第三层泛化收益，彻底摆脱机械序数词。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写静态柱状图或饼图的主体段：横向对比不同国家/不同模型在不同开销维度上的占比差异，灵活运用倍数（double/triple）、分数（nearly a third）与排序结构。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: In Group 1, A is 46%, B is 24%, C is 18%, D is 7%, and E is 5%. In Group 2, C is 52%, B is 22%, A is 15%, D is 6%, and E is 5%.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L027 段尾留钩与段首咬合：跨段落无缝过渡法则（Paragraph-to-Paragraph Handshake））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 把文字写成了 CSV 表格转储，完全没有归并次要项，也没有提炼倍差与结构反差。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

A strikingly different profile emerges in onboard robotic control loops, where high-frequency sensor preprocessing dominates energy usage at 51%, while attention overhead contracts to just 16%. Across both deployment settings, memory offloading and actuation decoding collectively account for under 11% of total consumption. This contrast highlights that optimization bottlenecks shift from quadratic token mixing on cloud servers to raw sensory I/O on physical robots.

focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人要求补测最新基线模型，或者质疑我们的提升是不是因为参数量更大/训练更久。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: We added the baseline X you asked for. Our model is 0.182 and X is 0.205, so we are still better. Also our model does not have many parameters.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L017 局限性（Limitations）的无损诚实写法：界定适用边界而非自毁贡献）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 过于单薄，特别是回应参数量质疑时只口头说 does not have many parameters，远不如构造一个缩小版 `Ours-Small` 依然吊打对手有说服力。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Following your suggestion, we benchmarked against the two recent baselines (TimeMixer and FreTS) and evaluated a capacity-reduced variant of our architecture (`DyTS-Lite`) in Table R3. Across all horizons on Weather and ECL, standard DyTS-Net reduces MSE by 9.6% over TimeMixer and 13.4% over FreTS. Furthermore, to ensure strict capacity fairness, `DyTS-Lite` shrinks the hidden dimension to $d=64$—requiring 42% fewer parameters and 55% fewer FLOPs than TimeMixer—yet still outperforms TimeMixer by 6.8% in average MSE. This confirms that our gains stem from structural-scale disentanglement rather than model size.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Instantiating closed-loop visuomotor diffusion on physical robots entails two technical challenges. First, because raw depth camera streams contain occlusion artifacts around reflective object edges, we introduce a tactile-guided cross-attention gate that reweights visual tokens upon contact onset. Second, to eliminate the 200 ms sampling bottleneck of iterative denoising, we formulate a trajectory consistency distillation objective that maps Gaussian noise directly to collision-free action chunks in two forward steps. Together, these designs sustain 50 Hz reactive control under partial visual occlusion.
